answers: issue-acceptance finding 3:** nothing to do — AMDR-1[no-code] correctly specifies that the ADR-006 amendment (step 3.6 with test names inline) is implemented by the build stage, and resume-rehydrate-test.sh is the TESTFILES entry that will grep for the required amendment text. The issue-acceptance stage cannot see amendment content that the build stage has not yet written; the design's acceptance contract makes this testable: if the amendment is absent, the grep assertion fails. This is correctly a build-stage concern.

issue-acceptance finding 4:** nothing to do — AMDR-2[no-code] correctly specifies that the ADR-050 §6 boundary note is implemented by the build stage, with resume-rehydrate-test.sh as the verifying test. Same reasoning as finding 3: the design cannot show diff content it does not produce; the test fails when the amendment is not written.
